title: Evidence ledger entry
description: One row per factual claim that enters the partner pipeline. Phase 1 authoring artifact.

claim.description: One atomic factual statement. No recommendation, no causal language.

source_path.description: Repo-relative path, URL, or export identifier. No secrets.

source_timestamp.description: When the source was produced or captured (ISO 8601).

period_start.description: ISO date; null if the claim is not period-bound.

period_end.description: ISO date; null if the claim is not period-bound.

timezone.description: IANA tz used for period_start/period_end, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Use 'n/a' if not period-bound.

filters.description: Every filter applied to obtain raw_result (country, device, query set, page set, segment, etc.). Empty object if none.

calculation.description: Exact transformation from source to raw_result (formula, aggregation, dedup rule). 'none' if raw copy.

raw_result.description: The unmodified result value(s) the claim rests on.

alternative_explanations.description: At least one alternative explanation for the observed result, even if weak.

falsification_test.description: A concrete check that would prove the claim false if the claim were false.

limitations.description: What this evidence does not establish; collection gaps; sample limits.
